jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer, Platform
jobs.content: <p>We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer to build batch and streaming pipelines.</p><h3>What you'll do</h3><ul><li>Own pipelines in Spark and Airflow</li><li>Model data in dbt and Snowflake</li></ul><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>5+ years of Python and SQL</li><li>Experience with Kafka</li></ul><p>The annual base salary range for this role in San Francisco is $180,000 - $250,000 USD per year. This role is full-time.</p>
